round: two-round visual comparison (V1 glass density + V2 context directions)
methodology: Hand-built, no external skill execution. Adheres to Apple HIG materials principle: glass is for controls/navigation only, never for content cards.

index.html.role: Directory — entry point linking V1 + V2 with thumbnails

v1-glass-density/compare.html.role: V1 main — 4 density variants (A ultra-thin, B regular, C thick, D hybrid) of the same dashboard over the same warm-sunset background, shown 2x2

v1-glass-density/index.html.role: V1 overview — 4 cards summarizing each density variant

v2-contexts/compare-v2.html.role: V2 overview — 4 direction cards with thumbnail iframes, each opens in its own tab

v2-contexts/v2-a-macos26.html.role: V2-A: macOS 26 Tahoe — heavy glass on warm sunset wallpaper, SF Pro, full command palette modal

v2-contexts/v2-b-linear.html.role: V2-B: developer-tool dark (Linear/Vercel style) — icon rail, subtle glass topbar, JetBrains Mono accents, near-black background

v2-contexts/v2-c-editorial.html.role: V2-C: editorial / magazine — Charter serif, drop cap, pull quote, SVG bar chart, roman-numeral activity feed, warm paper

v2-contexts/v2-d-engdoc.html.role: V2-D: engineering doc / operator reference — JetBrains Mono everywhere, prop API table, ASCII resource tree, terminal output

shared_data.narrative: Same Q2 pipeline review for Northwind workspace, week 24 2026

decisions_to_make.v1_question: How much glass? (A ultra-thin / B regular / C thick / D hybrid)
decisions_to_make.v2_question: What context is this product? (A system-native macOS 26 / B dark dev tool / C editorial / D engineering doc)
